name: sprite-frame-editor
description: 精灵帧动画编辑器：图片 → 循环视频 → 2D 帧动画 → 帧序列导出
author: SpriteFrameEditor contributors

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.dist:win: npm run icon && npm run build && npm run clean:win && electron-builder --win --x64 --config.directories.output=build/windows-x64 && node scripts/package-dir.mjs windows-x64 && node scripts/prune-models.mjs windows-x64
scripts.dist:win:only: npm run icon && npm run clean:win && electron-builder --win --x64 --config.directories.output=build/windows-x64 && node scripts/package-dir.mjs windows-x64 && node scripts/prune-models.mjs windows-x64
